_note: Frozen analysis quantities, written 2026-11-21 before any output of the trained detector was produced (training run R2 still in progress). Values marked AI-proposed still await author sign-off (OPEN_QUESTIONS items 2-3).
frequency_strata: train-instance tertiles, 10/10/10 classes, sorted by count desc then id (pilot rule)
frame_consistency: exclude images whose JSON->JPEG x/y scale differ by >1% (single-pest close-ups)

grouping.audit_rule: val image kept iff its near-duplicate component contains no train image

candidate_dump.std_readout: class-aware, single label per anchor (Ultralytics predict default)
candidate_dump.ml_readout: multi-label per anchor (same forward pass) - CCPR evidence only

merge_readout_primary.note: sahi get_sliced_prediction defaults, applied to the floor-level dump

matching.rule: COCO-style greedy one-to-one, per class, by descending score

ledger_stages: M matched in merged scored list
primary_endpoint: 3-category multinomial over pooled tail-small misses in the audit set, counts + cluster percentile bootstrap CI

statistics.bootstrap: cluster percentile, resample audit groups, 2000 resamples, seed 0
statistics.frequency_contrast: tail-small vs size-standardized head-small, bootstrap CI + class-label permutation p (10000)
statistics.head_NI: one-sided paired cluster bootstrap, delta=1.0pp if >=20 groups and >=200 head events else 2.0pp if >=10 groups

posthoc_fitting: 5-fold group cross-fitting on the audit set (parameters never fit on the fold they score)
method_comparison: each method at (a) its own fitted operating point and (b) a global threshold matching the baseline total FP count
ccpr_go_no_go: >=5 additional tail-small TPs vs class x size calibration
95% cluster-bootstrap CI of tail-small recall difference excludes 0
